Definition: from G697; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill:--Areopagite.
BiblicalUsage: The word means an Areopagite, a member of the council that met on Mars' Hill. It appears once, naming Dionysius the Areopagite, who believed when Paul preached in Athens.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one man from the council believing is enough to show that the gospel can reach the highest seats in the city.
